description: Swift extension for CronSettings providing UI components for displaying and interacting with CronJob objects, including job rows, context menus, detail headers, detail cards, run history, and payload summaries.

methods.name: jobRow
methods.description: Creates a UI view representing a row for a specific CronJob, displaying its status and name.

methods.name: jobContextMenu
methods.description: Provides a context menu with actions (Run now, Open transcript, Enable/Disable, Edit, Delete) for a given CronJob.

methods.name: detailHeader
methods.description: Creates a detailed header view for a CronJob with its name, ID, and control buttons.

methods.name: detailCard
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a CronJob, including schedule, description, agent, session, wake mode, next run, last run, status, errors, and payload.

methods.name: runHistoryCard
methods.description: Shows the run history log entries for a CronJob, with refresh capability.

methods.name: runRow
methods.description: Displays individual run log entry details such as status, date, duration, summary, and errors.

methods.name: payloadSummary
methods.description: Provides a visualization of the job's payload content based on its type.
